name: sprc-slurm-mods
description: Claude Code mod for the sprc Slurm cluster: a live cluster/job dashboard pane, status line, job lifecycle tools, finish notifications and submit guardrails.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to refresh cluster and job state from Slurm. Minimum 10.

autoOpen.title: Open the dashboard at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the sprc pane beside the chat when a session starts (only placed on wide terminals).

guards.title: Submit guardrails
guards.description: enforce: block commands Slurm or the cluster would reject, and sleep/squeue polling loops; warn: let them run but tell the model; off: no checks (submitted jobs are still followed).

liveContext.title: Live cluster context
liveContext.description: Attach a one-line cluster summary to prompts that mention jobs, GPUs or Slurm.
